verdict.rationale: Greptile is an AI code review agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows Greptile serving its own MCP server to other agents like Cursor, Claude Code and Codex (greptile-docs-23, greptile-docs-24, greptile-probe-4). That is the opposite role, and nothing shows Greptile connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.
